entities.summary: Haiti is a sovereign nation in Caribbean, Americas. Its capital is Port-au-Prince. Official languages include French, Haitian Creole (Krèyol ayisyen). Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic (effectively failed state since 2021 assassination). Population: approximately 11.7 million. Area: 27,750 km². Comprehensive index for Haiti covering Taíno cacicazgos (Hispaniola), Columbus 1492, Spanish colonization, French Saint-Domingue (richest colony in world), sugar/slavery (half million enslaved, Code Noir, brutal conditions), Haitian Revolution 1791-1804 (only successful slave revolution, Toussaint Louverture, Dessalines, defeated Napoleon), first Black republic, independence 1804, France's extortionate indemnity (150M francs, economic crippling), Duvalier dictatorships (Papa Doc/Baby Doc), political instability, 2010 earthquake (300,000 dead), and ongoing crises.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Haitian Revolution (1791-1804) was the only successful slave revolt in modern history, resulting in Haiti becoming the first independent Black republic and a major blow to the transatlantic slave trade. Its impact on global abolitionist movements and the struggle for racial equality continues to be felt today.
